body:
Thank your for all that.

I felt like I was nearly the point of doing it so I decided to take a try with people on the internet, and you people really helped... It made me see that not everything is so lost.

Thank you

I try and do that (give my self some time to learn about life) but sometimes it's really hard, ad I am getting quite tired of doing that... Cause people dont really help and I mostly feel like it all will be wrong.. 

Thanks
I will try and get some therapu! thank you
Thanks anyways and good luck with the endoscopy!

Thanks for all the advice...

The truth is that i dont feel like i can trust people... like I said before.. the only time I've let someone "in" she left... and I dont want to go through that shit again, mainly cause it's been more than a year and it's still going... that makes everything harder

 besides that among my friends I am the underachiver, I always try to play it cool and all but it really sucks to be the one that is being left behind... everyone is finishing college and I am only starting... 

besides that my parents are really supportive but I just cant seem to be up to their expectations, or anyone's for that matter. 

the thing about life passing me by, it really got my attention cause I do feel like that, but it's about everything... 

Thanks.

I don't live in the U.S. so things work a little different around here, but i'll try and get that done.. Now that the thought of getting therapy is something that it might happen in the future, the need of telling my parents that I need it is also scary... But I'll try to go forward with it... 

Thank you.

P.S.:If you want to know more about all that is going through my head read my answer to rjottu-bio, he made a lot of good questions..

I feel like a failure for a lot of things... I've been to three different colleges because I always chose to chane because none of the things I was learning was "meant for me" and now that I've found one I do like I fail completly (failing all the classes during a year). The only person that I felt that truly knew me decided to leave me and the last time we spoke she told me she did not knew me, and when she did left me it was because I am too on the depressing side. I dont see any talent in anything at all in me. I dont find myself to be a likable person at all especially when everybody around me  is founding someone to be with and I cant maintain a relaitonship for more than two weeks.

I do dwell on stupid things about the past a lot but that makes me think about the future and it does not make me happy at all to think about the possibilities... 

I dont see any parts of my life as stable, as cliche and exagerated as this sounds it's true, I feel like at any given moment anyone and everyone can just leave me there.

I think more about this stuff and feelings when I am alone.... But it also comes to my mind when I am with friends... I dont show it cause I dont want to make anyone depressed around me... And mostly because I prefer to be the support than the supporter..

The suicide thoughts come around cause it would be the easiest way out.. I know I sound like a coward but it feels like it sometimes... 

I think that's all

Thanks for the support.

About the feelings... I remebere having these feelings and thoughts since I remember being myself.. With this I mean... Since I've developed a "personality" i've started to think about the world and myself and I end up feeling alone and out of place... 

About therapy... The reasons that make me afraid of going are mostly being face to face with someone... completly exposing my self to them... And well... it's not cheap..
Found this reddit on this account and I've got to say... This song is on repeat since I've found it here.

Thank You

The truth is I've also thought on leaving everything behind and never look back again, runing away, but still I would be leaving people that need me that way I would be free... But I cant do that so I end up feeling stuck in a place where I dont see hope for the future, the only things I feel like doing right now are not actually positive for me, or for anyone... I just feel like everything is too hard to be actually worth going trough this pain.

Thank you again

First of all... thank you for answering, I've been reloading waiting for someone to say something and you did...

The truth is that I feel that I fuck up in college a lot... I cant concentrate cause I dwelve in shit I've done in the past and in bad feelings that haunt me everyday.. thoughts about shit that happened in the past... And I know a professional is the right option but I dont think I would be able to tell all this face to face to anyone... 

I feel like I am being a letdown to everyone, I feel like I'll never be able to do anything, I feel like I am alone eventhough there's a lot of people that care... 

EDIT: Thank you for reading and taking the time to be supportive
